capabilities: Render D2 code blocks as diagrams
Choose layout engine, theme, and sketch mode
Use installed D2 CLI on desktop
extras: Bundled compiler cannot import files from disk. Obsidian Sync Standard users must install or update on each device because the bundled compiler exceeds that plan's 5 MB per-file limit. D2 language documentation is hosted in the D2 repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render D2 diagram source into diagrams inside notes.

relations.evidence: the plugin uses your installed D2 CLI when available

summary: Diagram scripting plugin that renders D2 text code blocks into diagrams in Live Preview and Reading view.
